name: Cheesy Ground Beef & Mushroom Sandwiches with Arugula-Radish Salad

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 220°C (425°F). Line two baking sheet pans with aluminum foil to make clean up easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg cremini mushrooms
1 ½ bunches radish
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice mushrooms and place in a large bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms, onion, and spices to the pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, about 8 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp balsamic vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and thinly slice radishes; add to the bowl with the dressing and set aside.
When the veggies are tender, add beef and cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and cooked through, 6-8 minutes.
While the beef is cooking, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
When the beef is done, add vinegar, stir to combine, and remove from heat.

Split buns in half and divide between the baking sheets, cut-side up. Top with beef mixture and sprinkle with cheese. Working in batches, place in the oven and broil until cheese is melted and golden, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, add arugula to the bowl with the dressing and radish; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide sandwiches and salad between plates. Enjoy!
